author: agent:claude-code
message: parda's replaced graft: its prototype of the small types already sits at glam parity except the Mat4 inverse, so lanes M1 becomes adopting it plus a SIMD Mat4 inverse and the NEON / simd128 paths, springs move to M2 with parda's timeline, and the no_std path gains a lean feature set for compile time. Also the cargo deny check's command after licenses moved to tend check. (proposal 01a10a6b-8d12-7518-bcc1-b234e127bbbc, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

text: Vec2, Vec3, Vec4, Mat3 and Mat4 generic over Float: column-major, #[repr(C)], bytemuck Pod for f32 and f64, with products, transpose, determinant, inverses, rotations, translation, scale, project_point3, and compose_world (world[i] = world[parent[i]] * local[i] in one pass). Adopted from parda-2d's prototype (crates/autodyne-math in parda2D at 7912896, written against autodyne's units), with a SIMD Mat4 inverse at least as fast as glam's and single-value SSE, NEON and wasm simd128 paths.

One crate, two paths: the default `std` feature as today, and without it core + alloc, float maths through libm in the units traits, compile-time target features in place of runtime CPU detection, and no std-only caches. flux, gpu, linalg (faer) and what builds on it (systems, ode) stay behind std. A lean feature set (units, simd, geometry) compiles only those modules, in seconds rather than the ~90 s a release build with default-features = false takes today. CI builds the no_std path for wasm32 and runs the tests on both.
